data.name: Error.2610.Message
data.value: 1. Spline interpolation error (Spline file) 2. Can't open spline file 3. Spline file is broken 4. Spline file is not supported. 5. Can't change spline file. 6. Can't get data. 7. The setting of Ex-T is illegal 8. Cannot make the spline file

data.name: Error.2610.Cause
data.value: 1. Spline interpolation error (Spline file): An error related to the spline file occurred. 2. Can't open spline file: The spline file corresponding to the spline No. designated with the MvSpl command could not be opened. 3. Spline file is broken: The spline file contents did not match the checksum. 4. Spline file is not supported.: The designated spline file cannot be used with the current controller. 5. Can't change spline file.: The target spline file is currently being used for spline interpolation (file is open). 6. Can't get data.: The spline file is closed so the data cannot be retrieved. 7. The setting of Ex-T is illegal: The setting of Ex-T is illegal 8. Cannot make the spline file: The specified spline file is opened already

data.name: Error.2610.Measures
data.value: 1. Spline interpolation error (Spline file): Refer to the error details No. and check the details of the occurring error. Then take actions for those error details. 2. Can't open spline file: Check that the spline No. designation is correct, and that the target spline file is saved in the controller. 3. Spline file is broken: Open the target spline file and check the contents. Then, save the file again to recreate the spline file. Write the new file to the controller again. 4. Spline file is not supported.: Check the spline file and controller versions. It may be necessary to upgrade the software version. 5. Can't change spline file.: A spline file currently being used for spline interpolation (file is open) cannot be exported to the controller, deleted or renamed. Carry these out after spline interpolation ends. 6. Can't get data.: Reset the program, and then execute the MvSpl command again. 7. The setting of Ex-T is illegal: Please confirm the number and the content of the file 8. Cannot make the spline file: Please confirm the specified number

data.name: Error.2611.Message
data.value: 1. Spline interpolation error (path point) 2. Path points are too close (nnnn) 3. The posture variation is too large (nnnn) 4. Path point's configuration flag is incorrect (nnnn) 5. Path point is not registered 6. Cannot open the path point file 7. The format of file is different 8. The number of point is illegal

data.name: Error.2611.Cause
data.value: 1. Spline interpolation error (path point): An error related to the path point registered in the spline file has occurred. 2. Path points are too close (nnnn): The distance between path points is too short, or the speed command in respect to the path point distance is too high. 3. The posture variation is too large (nnnn): The variation in posture between path points is too large. (The posture variation angle exceeds 150 degrees.) 4. Path point's configuration flag is incorrect (nnnn): A different path point is registered for the configuration flag value. 5. Path point is not registered: The Specified path point is not registered 6. Cannot open the path point file: The specified path point file does not exist 7. The format of file is different: The format of file is different 8. The number of point is illegal: The number of path point is illegal

data.name: Error.2611.Measures
data.value: 1. Spline interpolation error (path point): Refer to the error details No. and check the details of the occurring error. Then take actions for those error details. 2. Path points are too close (nnnn): "nnnn" in the error message indicates the path point No. causing the error. Review this path point's posi- tion, or review the spline interpolation command speed. * The high speed spline interpolation command has been added to the software version A3a. With this function enabled, a command speed higher than what was previously possible can be specified for the distance between the respective path points. Refer to the separate manual "Instruction Manual/Detailed Explanation of Functions and Operations" in details. 3. The posture variation is too large (nnnn): "nnnn" in the error message indicates the path point No. causing the error. Review the posture so that the posture variation amount for this path point is smaller, or add a path point to reduce the posture variation amount in the single block. 4. Path point's configuration flag is incorrect (nnnn): "nnnn" in the error message indicates the path point No. causing the error. Review this path point's posi- tion, and change it so it is the same configuration flag as the other path points. 5. Path point is not registered: Please confirm the number and the content of the file 6. Cannot open the path point file: Please confirm the file name and existence of the file 7. The format of file is different: Please confirm the format of the file 8. The number of point is illegal: Please confirm the file and the content of the file

data.name: Error.2612.Message
data.value: 1. Spline interpolation error (Execution error) 2. The robot does not support spline interpolation. 3. Can't execute with these start condition 4. Another spline interpolation is being executed 5. Can't execute step return

data.name: Error.2612.Cause
data.value: 1. Spline interpolation error (Execution error): An error related to the spline interpolation execution conditions occurred. 2. The robot does not support spline interpolation.: Spline interpolation was attempted with a robot that does not support spline interpolation. 3. Can't execute with these start condition: Spline interpolation was attempted with a robot program in a slot having the start conditions ALWAYS ERROR. 4. Another spline interpolation is being executed: Multiple spline interpolations cannot be executed simultaneously. 5. Can't execute step return: Step return was attempted in respect to spline interpolation.

data.name: Error.2612.Measures
data.value: 1. Spline interpolation error (Execution error): Refer to the error detail No. and check the details of the occuring error. Then take action for those error details. 2. The robot does not support spline interpolation.: Use a different command than spline interpolation. 3. Can't execute with these start condition: Spline interpolation cannot be executed with a slot having the start conditions ALWAYS ERROR. Delete spline interpolation or change the start conditions to START. 4. Another spline interpolation is being executed: Check whether spline interpolation was attempted with a different robot during spline interpolation, or whether spline interpolation was directly attempted while spline interpolation was halted. 5. Can't execute step return: Spline interpolation does not support the step return operation. Do not attempt step return.

data.name: Error.2613.Message
data.value: 1. Spline interpolation error (interpolation process) 2. Not enough path points 3. Not enough arc designated points (nnnn) 4. Block data calculation error (ssssssss) 5. Block data does not exist 6. Spline interpolation command calculation error (nnnn)

data.name: Error.2613.Cause
data.value: 1. Spline interpolation error (interpolation process): An error occurred during the spline interpolation process. 2. Not enough path points: There are less than four path points registered in the spline file. 3. Not enough arc designated points (nnnn): Three consecutive path points are not designated for the spline interpolation arc. 4. Block data calculation error (ssssssss): An error occurred in the process to calculate the data related to the spline interpolation block. 5. Block data does not exist: The load in the process for the controller during spline interpolation was large, and the data for the spline interpolation block could not be generated in time. 6. Spline interpolation command calculation error (nnnn): An error occurred in the process for calculating the spline interpolation position commands.

data.name: Error.2613.Measures
data.value: 1. Spline interpolation error (interpolation process): Refer to the error details No. and check the details of the occurring error. Then take actions for those error details. 2. Not enough path points: At least four path points are required to execute spline interpolation. Use a spline file in which four or more path points are registered. 3. Not enough arc designated points (nnnn): The number of points in the arc containing the path point No. "nnnn" displayed in the error message is insufficient. To generate an arc, an arc for three consecutive path points must be designated. This error occurs if there are only two consecutive points. Add another path point in the arc designation to move with an arc path. 4. Block data calculation error (ssssssss): The details of the error differ according to "ssssssss" in the error message. - Reg.Pt.: The information on the number of path points saved in the spline file does not match the number of path points actually registered. Open the spline file in the Spline File Edit screen once, save it again and export it to the controller. - Cir.Arc: The arc could not be generated. Check that the path points for the arc designation are not arranged on a straight line. - Frm.Cnv.: The frame transformation calculation failed. Review the path point positions. - Blk.Stp.: Generation of the data for the block stopped, and spline interpolation could not be executed. Reset the program. - PtoJ.: The joint angle cannot be calculated at the position. Review the path point positions. 5. Block data does not exist: Check whether the load in the spline interpolation execution process can be reduced in the following ways. - Stop simultaneous execution of functions related to movement such as the collision detection function or visual control function. - Review the multi-tasks and reduce the number of slots executed simultaneously. - Reduce the dedicated output signal assignments. - Reduce the spline interpolation command speed. 6. Spline interpolation command calculation error (nnnn): Review the position of path point No. "nnnn" indicated in the error message or the MvSpl command argument’s setting value. Check that the cancel angle is set correctly. (Does the spline curve bend suddenly?)

data.name: Error.2614.Cause

Tracking function is enabled: The tracking function was enabled when attempting spline interpolation. 3. Can't change tool/base setting: The tool/base setting was changed during spline interpolation execution. 4. Can't execute Jrc command: The Jrc command was executed during spline interpolation.

data.name: Error.2614.Measures
data.value: 1. Spline interpolation error (other functions): Refer to the error details No. and check the details of the occurring error. Then take actions for those error details. 2. Tracking function is enabled: Spline interpolation and tracking function cannot be executed simultaneously. Disable the tracking function before executing spline interpolation. 3. Can't change tool/base setting: The tool/base setting cannot be changed during spline interpolation (including when halted). Change the settings after spline interpolation ends. 4. Can't execute Jrc command: The Jrc command cannot be executed during spline interpolation (including when halted). Execute the command after spline interpolation ends.

Output signal exceeds range (nnnn) 5. Tolerance setting value exceeds range (nnnn) 6. Interpolation setting information exceeds range 7. Header information exceeds range

data.name: Error.2615.Cause
data.value: 1. Spline interpolation error (exceeds setting range): A setting value related to spline interpolation exceeds the setting range. 2. M_SplVar setting value exceeds setting range: A value exceeding the range was substituted into M_SplVar. 3. M_SplVar setting range exceeds setting range (nnnn): A value exceeding the setting range is set in the spline file. 4. Output signal exceeds range (nnnn): The head No. for the signal output in the spline file exceeds the range. 5. Tolerance setting value exceeds range (nnnn): The tolerance designation in the spline file exceeds the range. 6. Interpolation setting information exceeds range: Data with value exceeding the range was found in the spline file interpolation setting information. 7. Header information exceeds range: Data with value exceeding the range was found in the spline file header information.

data.name: Error.2615.Measures
data.value: 1. Spline interpolation error (exceeds setting range): Refer to the error details No. and check the details of the occurring error. Then take actions for those error details. 2. M_SplVar setting value exceeds setting range: Substitute a value within the setting range (0 to 32767). 3. M_SplVar setting range exceeds setting range (nnnn): Change the setting for the path point No. "nnnn" indicated in the error message so it is within the range (-1 to 32767). 4. Output signal exceeds range (nnnn): Change the head No. of the signal output for the path point No. "nnnn" indicated in the error message so it is within the range (-1 to 32767). 5. Tolerance setting value exceeds range (nnnn): Change the tolerance designation for the path point No. "nnnn" indicated in the error message so it is within the range (0 to 100). 6. Interpolation setting information exceeds range: Open the target spline file and check the contents. Then, save the file again to recreate the spline file. Write the new file to the controller again. 7. Header information exceeds range: Open the target spline file and check the contents. Then, save the file again to recreate the spline file.
